executive_summary: The automated test report for the web application at https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com reveals several security vulnerabilities due to missing HTTP security headers. While the smoke tests passed successfully, the absence of critical security headers poses a significant risk to the application's security posture.

ai_issues.title: Missing HSTS header
ai_issues.root_cause: The HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) header is not set, which can expose the application to man-in-the-middle attacks.
ai_issues.business_impact: Without HSTS, users may be vulnerable to attacks that could compromise sensitive data, leading to potential data breaches and loss of user trust.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Implement the HSTS header to enforce secure connections over HTTPS.

ai_issues.title: Missing CSP header
ai_issues.root_cause: The Content Security Policy (CSP) header is not set, which can allow the execution of malicious scripts.
ai_issues.business_impact: Lack of CSP can lead to cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks, potentially compromising user data and application integrity.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Define and implement a Content Security Policy to restrict the sources of content that can be loaded.

ai_issues.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
ai_issues.root_cause: The X-Content-Type-Options header is not set, which can lead to MIME type sniffing vulnerabilities.
ai_issues.business_impact: This can result in the execution of malicious files, potentially compromising user data and application security.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Add the X-Content-Type-Options header with the value 'nosniff' to prevent MIME type sniffing.

ai_issues.title: Missing X-Frame-Options header
ai_issues.root_cause: The X-Frame-Options header is not set, which can allow clickjacking attacks.
ai_issues.business_impact: Clickjacking can lead to unauthorized actions being performed on behalf of the user, compromising user trust and application security.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Implement the X-Frame-Options header to prevent the application from being framed by other sites.

ai_issues.title: Missing Referrer-Policy header
ai_issues.root_cause: The Referrer-Policy header is not set, which can lead to the leakage of sensitive URL information.
ai_issues.business_impact: Sensitive information in URLs can be exposed to third parties, potentially leading to privacy issues.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Set the Referrer-Policy header to control the amount of referrer information sent with requests.

ai_issues.title: Missing Permissions-Policy header
ai_issues.root_cause: The Permissions-Policy header is not set, which can allow the use of browser features without explicit permission.
ai_issues.business_impact: Unauthorized use of browser features can lead to privacy and security concerns.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Implement the Permissions-Policy header to control the use of browser features.

positive_findings: All smoke tests passed successfully, indicating basic functionality is intact.
No performance issues were detected, with an average response time of 660ms.
No visual issues were reported, suggesting the UI is rendering correctly.
